findings.title: Valid blob sources containing /tree/ are misclassified by the preparation CLI
findings.trigger: A canonical fixed blob URL whose repository is named tree, or whose blob path contains a tree directory, enters the tree branch because the helper searches the entire URL string.

reproduction.fixture: Real local synthetic Git commits with normal blob docs/note.txt and docs/tree/note.txt, immutable candidate and producer Handoff. Only Git fetch routing is replaced for the local fixture.
reproduction.control: synthetic/source + docs/note.txt: helper accepts and formal Consumer accepts.

findings.expected: All three canonical fixed blob sources prepare successfully with kind=blob, preserving original source strings and fixed bytes.
findings.actual: Two supported blob URLs raise ValueError: canonical fixed Git URL required at fixed_url(..., kind=tree). The unchanged Consumer accepts all three when the canonical blob target is explicitly declared in an independent manifest oracle.
findings.impact: Documented prepare_crossref_bundle.py workflow cannot produce delivery records for valid ordinary source layouts/repository names. No unsafe acceptance or data execution was observed; this is a deterministic normal-path failure, currently missed by 173/245 tests and the B1 fixture.
affected_requirements: X-2 normal fixed blob resolution in preparation workflow
X-7 additional condition: candidate blob source delivery
fix_conditions: Derive blob/tree kind from the canonical GitHub route segment after owner/repository, not from a substring anywhere in the URL. Preserve all current full-commit/path/URL safety checks.
Add regression cases for repository name tree, blob path containing /tree/, regular blob sources, and actual tree sources; both helper preparation and Consumer should accept the intended valid cases.
Run required regression and independent verification on the new fixed implementation head. Current Test/Review/B1 evidence must not be automatically reused as a clean review of a changed head.
